exposure: sonographic features of the lower uterine segment (LUS)
outcome: successful vaginal birth after cesarean section (VBAC)
cohort: Women over 18 years old with open family planning who underwent a first cesarean section and had no history of additional uterine surgery or vertical/inverted T uterotomy.
finding: Increased lower uterine segment (LUS) thickness in the first trimester was significantly associated with higher odds of successful vaginal birth after cesarean section (VBAC), with this association weakening in later trimesters.
mod_finding: Increased first trimester LUS thickness was associated with higher odds of successful VBAC.
gest_age: Measurements taken at first, second, and third trimesters of pregnancy
